Healthcare Marketing Agency for Medical Practices: SEO, Maps, Google Ads and Websites

We help medical practices get found, understood and contacted: in Google search, Google Maps and AI assistants, and on a website that turns visits into calls and appointment requests. We started in 2013 as a website repair company, so we fix the technical foundation before we build anything on top of it. Today we work with specialists, multi-office groups, urgent care centers, ERs and dental practices, starting with Houston, Dallas and Miami.

This page is for practice owners and administrators. We are a marketing and website agency, not a medical provider.

Specialty Practice Patient Search

For Specialty Practices, Search Decides Who Gets the Patient, and the Referral

Specialty patients research longer. They search their condition and procedure, compare specialists’ credentials, ask AI to explain treatments and recommend doctors, check reviews and insurance, and often confirm a referral online before they call.

Why Your Specialty Website Must Be Ready for Every Platform

For GI, cardiology, plastic surgery, orthopedics and other specialties, patients and referring doctors look for proof of expertise. If your procedures, physicians and credentials aren’t clear and consistent, AI and Google send them elsewhere.

  • GGoogle Search & AI Overviews: answer condition and procedure questions before anyone clicks; detailed, accurate pages get referenced.
  • AIChatGPT, Gemini & Copilot: recommend specialists by name, favoring physicians with clear credentials and consistent profiles.
  • $Google Ads: captures procedure-intent patients when campaigns follow healthcare ad policies and land on trustworthy pages.
  • ★Reviews & social: confirm the experience and outcomes patients can expect.

Choose your specialty

Start with your specialty: the work changes more than most agencies admit

A GI group needs procedure and referral pages; a plastic surgery practice needs consultation tracking; a cardiology group needs subspecialist and office structure; an urgent care needs accurate hours and wait information. Pick the closest match in the directory below, or read how we group the work.

Procedure-based specialists

Gastroenterology, cardiology, urology, orthopedics, vascular and general surgery: physician, procedure and referral pages carry most of the weight.

Elective and cosmetic

Plastic surgery, dermatology and ophthalmology: procedure information, credentials and consultation tracking matter most.

Ongoing and primary care

Primary care, pediatrics, endocrinology, rheumatology: new-patient information, capacity and referral requirements.

Walk-in and emergency

Urgent care and ERs: accurate hours, locations and fast contact paths, covered on our dedicated pages.

We start with a live, screen-shared review: your site, Maps position, competitors and what AI tools say about you, explained on a video call rather than in a PDF days later.

  2. Prioritize

  3. Fix foundations

  4. Improve content and campaigns

    Physician, service and location pages; Google Ads where it fits.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly reporting and adjustments; nothing hidden.

How we work

  • Short-term projects or long-term partnership, satisfaction-based, cancellable with 7 days’ notice.
  • Independent consultant alongside your in-house team or current agency.
  • Territory exclusivity: we will not take a same-specialty competitor within your protected ZIP codes.
  • Pricing: scope-based proposal after review, with management fee, ad spend paid to Google, one-time website work and optional services separated. See our healthcare marketing cost guide.
  • Qualified-practice pilot: established practices in open territories may be offered a one-month pilot after their review. It is not available in reserved territories and is not a substitute for the complimentary audit.

Questions and consultation

Healthcare marketing agency questions

Straight answers for owners and administrators.

What does a healthcare marketing agency do?

It makes a medical practice easier to find, understand and contact, and shows what produced results: website repair and structure, local listings, physician, service and location pages, Google Ads where suitable, AI-search readiness and reporting. A good agency is also clear about what it cannot control.

How do we choose the right healthcare marketing agency?

Ask about specialty experience, who does the work, how fees and ad spend are separated, who owns the accounts, what monthly reports contain, exit terms, and whether they represent a competitor in your ZIP codes. Be cautious with guaranteed rankings or patient numbers.

Can you coordinate marketing for groups with several offices or specialties?

Yes. We build connected physician, service and office pages, one accurate Google profile per office, and reporting by office and specialty. Each office ZIP is checked for availability.

Can we keep our existing marketing company?

Yes. Many practices keep a coordinator or agency for social media and branding and use us as the technical, search and website specialist. We coordinate directly to avoid duplicated work.

How much does healthcare marketing cost?

It depends on offices, providers, website condition, competition and whether you run Google Ads. We send a scope-based proposal after review, with fees, ad spend, one-time work and optional services separated.

Is AI search optimization a replacement for SEO?

No. Google search, Maps, technical quality and clear content remain the foundation. AI-search readiness builds on that; nobody can guarantee an AI recommendation.

Do we need a healthcare marketing agency near us?

Location matters less than specialty understanding, responsiveness and honest reporting. We are in Houston and serve Dallas, Miami and other markets remotely, and we never claim offices we do not have.
